milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta concrete pillar is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 0), which is exactly 5 blocks from spawn. With max_distance=5, the player must move at least slightly toward the pillar AND face it within 60° to trigger completion. This ensures meaningful navigation rather than trivial satisfaction from spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The emerald block pillar is at spawn-relative (10, 1, 5), approximately 11.2 blocks from spawn. With max_distance=5, the player must navigate ~6+ blocks from spawn past the magenta concrete landmark to reach within 5 blocks of the emerald area AND face it within 60°. This enforces the dependency on finding the magenta concrete first as a navigational guide.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an emerald block results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must collect 9 emeralds from the chest at (10, 0, 6) and craft them into an emerald_block at the crafting table at (11, 0, 5). The player starts with no emerald blocks in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful crafting.
